session_summary: Session 3 delivered a peer support activity focusing on identifying a trusted adult for escalation and distinguishing between in-session completion and external service delivery. The student completed an agreed between-session task (attempting a small group interaction) but reported that the wider barrier of social isolation/uncertainty persists. No external support was delivered; only mentoring activities occurred.
primary_concern: Social isolation due to friend moving classes; uncertainty about timetable changes; difficulty planning ahead due to ambiguity.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Attempt one small group interaction if safe.
Identify a trusted adult for escalation if peer behaviour becomes harmful.
Request for clarification on confirmed vs. proposed support elements.

next_steps: Monitor completion of the between-session task to notice a comfortable setting.
Clarify which support elements are confirmed versus proposed before promising further assistance.
uncertainties: Whether the timetable change is permanent.
If external support will be approved or delivered in future sessions.
Whether the student can complete the between-session task without running out of time.
conclusion: The session successfully delivered peer support activities (identifying escalation contacts, rehearsing steps) and confirmed completion of the previous between-session task. The student explicitly distinguished between the completed mentoring activity and the lack of external support delivery. While the specific step was manageable, the wider barrier of social isolation/uncertainty remains unresolved on some days. Evidence supports that the session itself was helpful in clarifying steps and managing expectations, but improvement in the primary barrier is not yet established.
